arms.cfbd_close: CFBD multi-book close: median over providers of spread_espn_home_close / total_close, rows flagged ml_spread_sign_conflict or open_close_sign_conflict excluded; moneyline from the consensus pmf
arms.consensus: ESPN pinned median closing line (espn-lines-rule-1) as the margin / total mean; moneyline from a cover-balanced keyed pmf whose SD model is fit on TRAIN lined games (a baseline fit, not a v7 fit)
arms.opener: CFBD multi-book opener (median spread_espn_home_open / total_open, 2021+), same exclusions
arms.v5: artifact as served: intercept + slope * raw replay margin, slice SD table x conference scale x blowout widening, negative-binomial engine 200k sims, common random numbers per event (the recheck's arithmetic)
arms.v7: selected candidate, mean-centred keyed margin pmf; moneyline = P(margin > 0). The gate uses this arm.
arms.v7_alt: best validation candidate of the other prior family (with vs without CFBD), reported, never gating

rule.bootstrap: paired v7 - v5 deltas, resampling game dates (2000 resamples, seed 11), 95% percentile CI
rule.cfbd_arm: The CFBD preseason prior landed before this pin, so core and CFBD arms compete on validation and the holdout is read once for both (selected arm gates; the other family is reported as v7_alt). CFBD values are current-revised (as_published_verified false; 2026 fetched mid-season): any CFBD-arm gain is an UPPER BOUND. Used: returning_off_ppa_pct, talent_prev_season, recruiting_points_4yr_weighted, portal_out_stars_sum (portal arm only). Never used: portal IN (as-of-fetch destination), current-season talent, SP+.

gate_beats_v5_on_outcomes.applies_to: each scored v7 arm (selected and alt) separately, v7 minus v5 on the same games
gate_beats_v5_on_outcomes.coverage: v7 calls >= 97% of the holdout v5 rows
gate_beats_v5_on_outcomes.significant_improvement: margin MAE delta CI high < 0, or moneyline log loss delta CI high < 0

verdict.FAILED: core arm: margin MAE delta CI low > 0, or moneyline Brier delta CI low > 0 (significantly worse)
verdict.PASS -> WIRE AS CHALLENGER: the CORE arm (no CFBD) passes coverage, significant_improvement and no_point_regression; the CFBD arm is packaged only if it passes as well, otherwise the core arm is packaged
verdict.RESEARCH ONLY: otherwise; if only the CFBD arm passes, RESEARCH ONLY (its gain cannot be separated from current-revised CFBD values, which are also current-revised in the validation seasons)

rule.grid_history: lambda multipliers started at (0.5, 1, 2); 0.5 won on validation at the grid edge, so 0.25 was added before this pin (0.5 still won). The half-life grid (none, 45 days) was NOT extended although 45 won: the validation difference between them is about 0.015 points of margin MAE. Every grid change happened on train/validation numbers only; the holdout was unread.
rule.market_relative_cfbd: the same market block against the CFBD multi-book close; MAE vs the CFBD opener (2021+) for v7, v5, v7_alt (paired, date-clustered CI). Reported, not gating.

market_relative_reported_not_gating.MARKET_SKILL_if: orthogonalised slope CI low > 0 AND corr CI low > 0 (per market); else NO_MARKET_SKILL
market_relative_reported_not_gating.ats: disagreement >= 3 and >= 7 points: wins / losses / pushes, Wilson CI, ROI at a 52.4% break-even
market_relative_reported_not_gating.corr: corr(model - line, result - line), date-clustered bootstrap CI
market_relative_reported_not_gating.lines: ESPN pinned median closing spread and total (espn-lines-rule-1); DESIGN-INFORMED (read before)
market_relative_reported_not_gating.slope_orthogonalised: coefficient on (model - line) in OLS of (result - line) on [1, line, model - line]
market_relative_reported_not_gating.slope_plain: OLS slope of (result - line) on (model - line)

rule.pinned_before: the first and only v7 holdout read; validation numbers were known, holdout numbers were not
rule.point_in_time: decision = min(kickoff, 08:00 America/New_York on the kickoff's ET date); a game feeds ratings only if kickoff + 5 h <= decision. v5's replay admits games with start < kickoff (no buffer, same-day results): a small information advantage to v5 that is left in place.
rule.pre_read_steps: v5 reproduction (`v5repro`, no v7 file opened) must pass; the consensus pmf is fit on train and stored in the spec before the pin; the identical scoring path runs once on validation (`dryrun`); script, spec, prior files, the v5 reproduction and this rule are committed and unmodified; the read marker is written immediately before the first holdout file is opened.
rule.scored_set: v5 replay rows (every completed FBS-involved game) in the holdout window on which v7 makes a call; v5 and the consensus baseline are scored on exactly those games (consensus on the lined subset); no-calls and rows without facts are counted and reported, never scored.
secondary_reported_not_gating: weeks 0-4 (v5 replay week <= 4) vs 5-14 vs postseason: margin MAE, Brier, log loss deltas with CIs
calibration by favourite size (0-3/3-7/7-14/14-21/21+ projected margin)
total MAE (v7 vs v5 vs consensus)
v7 and v5 vs the consensus baseline on outcomes
rule.selection: prior arm ['core', 'cfbd', 'cfbd_portal'] x lambda multiplier [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0] x recency half-life [None, 45.0] x stage-2 feature set ['full', 'eff', 'pts']: lowest validation margin MAE (0.005-point ties -> lower validation total MAE). Prior rho / lambda / CFBD gammas from 2016-2021 finals (and those seasons' CFBD values) only. Margin pmf (SD model + key multipliers, ridge 10.0) and total bucket SDs fit on train for the selected candidate and for the best candidate of the other family (core vs CFBD), the 'alt' arm.

v5_reproduction_required.note: published in outputs/ncaaf/cfb_v5_margin_slope_recheck.md; checked on all v5 holdout rows first

windows.holdout: date > 2024-11-14 (2024-11-15 onwards, through the 2026-11-19 end of the v5 replay rows)
